content.introduction: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a unit of the United States Department of Labor, serving as the principal fact-finding agency for the U.S. government in the field of labor economics and statistics. It operates as an independent national statistical agency that collects, processes, analyzes, and disseminates essential statistical data to the public, the U.S. Congress, other federal agencies, state and local governments, businesses, and labor organizations. The BLS conducts the monthly Current Population Survey, which provides data on the employed, unemployed, and those not in the labor force, and the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW) program, which publishes a quarterly count of employment and wages reported by employers covering more than 95 percent of U.S. jobs. The BLS was founded in 1885 and has its headquarters in Washington, DC.
body: The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a unit of the United States Department of Labor. It is the principal fact-finding agency for the U.S. government in the broad field of labor economics and statistics and serves as a principal agency of the U.S. federal statistical system. The BLS collects, processes, analyzes, and disseminates essential statistical data to the American public, the U.S. Congress, other Federal agencies, state and local governments, businesses, and labor representatives. The Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW) program publishes a quarterly count of employment and wages reported by employers covering more than 95 percent of U.S. jobs, available at the county, MSA, state and national levels by industry.

The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a U.S. federal agency within Government Administration that serves as the primary source of data on labor economics and statistics. It operates as an independent national statistical agency that collects, processes, analyzes, and disseminates essential statistical data to the public, the U.S. Congress, other federal agencies, state and local governments, businesses, and labor organizations.
